Connectivity (Staging Urls and Credentials)
This web services can be accessed by both JSON services. All the method accepts only post data and will return JSON format data. Please use below URLs for development purpose.

Service URLs(JSON)
Domain/airlinehost/AirAPIService.svc/JSONService**Domain.in/tradehost/TradeAPIService.svc/JSONService

Credentials
The Credentials will be shared through E-mail.

Please make sure to choose Languages as HTTP on TOP.

Kindly follow the flow by clicking the Booking Flow

Booking Flow

BarCode Integration:
To generate the Barcode on printout at your end and, you have to capture the data in the following format. Note: We will not provide the DDL for the barcode integration and you have to use any third party DLL.

For One_Way
Last Name/First Name PNR FirstLegDepartureDate SecondLegDepartureDate CarrierCode FirstFlightLegNumber SecondFlightLegNumber DepartureStation ArrivalStation

For Return
Last Name/First Name PNR FirstLegDepartureDate SecondLegDepartureDate CarrierCode FirstFlightLegNumber SecondFlightLegNumber DepartureStation ArrivalStation FirstLegDepartureDateofReturnSegment SecondLegDepartureDateofReturnSegment CarrierCode FirstFlightLegNumberofReturnSegment SecondFlightLegNumberofReturnSegment DepartureStationofReturnSegment ArrivalStationofReturnSegment

Sample Data
TEST/ASDFASFA UBGDMA 18 Jan 2023 18 Jan 2023 G8 575 301 BOM DEL 27 Feb 2023 27 Feb 2023 G8 1764 381 DEL BOM





API ENDPOINTS:

1. http://domain/airlinehost/AirAPIService.svc/JSONService/Air_SectorAvailabilityPI
If you are purchasing only Series Fares, you need to call Air_SectorAvailability API and restrict sending the search requests to our API using the sectors received from this API.

If you are purchasing FD/Regular fares, do not restrict search requests to send to our API using the sectors received from this API. If required, you can get the list of sectors offline and restrict the search requests to send to the API.

Air_SectorAvailabilityPI API has to be called 3 or 4 times in a day and the response of available sectors and dates are to be cached.

Request Object : APIAirSectorAvailabilityPI Request
Name	Type	Description
Auth_Header	Object	This object holds API Authentication details
Auth_Header

Name	Type	Description	Mandatory
UserId	String	This requires the ID of the API user	Yes
Password	String	This requires the Password of the API user	Yes
Request_Id	String	This requires a unique ID for each booking	Yes
IP_Address	String	This requires a IP address of the system	Yes
IMEI_Number	String	This requires the IMEI number of the mobile device.	No
Response Object : APIAirSectorAvailabilityPI Response
a) APISectorPIs

Name	Type	Description
AvailableDates	String	Displays the list of Available Dates in MM/DD/YYYY format separated by
Destination	String	Displays the Destination
MaxTravelDate	String	If AvailableDates field is empty, fallback to the MaxTravelDate field, where The sector is considered available from the current date (today) up to and including MaxTravelDate.
Origin	String	Displays the Origin
Body

}
